avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP1A2 and MAO activity, reducing frovatriptan levels; also increases serotonergic activity increasing serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or discontinue St. John's Wort 2 weeks before frovatriptan therapy

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increases serotonin levels; combined with frovatriptan increases risk of serotonin syndrome

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor that elevates central serotonin; additive effect with triptan increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplemental L-tryptophan; counsel on dietary protein moderation if concurrent use necessary

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP1A2 induction may slightly reduce frovatriptan efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced migraine relief; consider dose adjustment if needed

caution_supplements.name: SAMe
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild serotonergic activity; theoretical additive effect though clinical significance is low
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution and monitor for serotonergic symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Tyramine may interact with monoamine pathways; triptans have mild MAOI-like activity in some contexts
avoid_foods.action: Limit tyramine-containing foods; counsel patient on dietary restrictions typical for triptan use

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay frovatriptan absorption and onset of action
caution_foods.action: Administer frovatriptan on empty stomach or with light meal for optimal efficacy

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Both frovatriptan and caffeine affect cerebral vasculature; additive vasoconstrictive effects possible
caution_foods.action: Advise moderate caffeine intake; excessive consumption may increase cardiovascular side effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity) especially if frovatriptan is combined with SSRIs, SNRIs, or other serotonergic agents. Assess for medication overuse headache if frovatriptan is used >10 days per month.
